Title: GA: Node OS patching - NodeImage feature in AKS

Body.Content:
Node OS patching – NodeImage feature is now generally available for AKS.  This feature provides an exclusive channel to control OS security updates for your nodes. With this feature, you can have a flexible and customized strategy for node-level OS security updates and a separate plan for cluster-level Kubernetes version auto-upgrades auto-upgrade.

Learn more.
